---
title: "local_edition() long accepted any number at all"
ref: PKG-03
categories: [Packages]
impact: incoherent
attendu: "an error, since only editions 2 and 3 exist"
versions: "Accepted up to {testthat} 3.2.3, an error since {testthat} 3.3.0"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2022), {testthat} 3.3.0 NEWS"
---

::: {.piege packages="testthat"}
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(testthat))

packageVersion("testthat")
local_edition(2.7)
edition_get()
```
:::

With {testthat} 3.3.0 or later, `local_edition(2.7)` is rejected. With an older version, the call goes through and `edition_get()` returns 2.7.

## Why

Up to {testthat} 3.2.3, `local_edition()` only checked that its argument was a single number. `local_edition(rnorm(1))` or `local_edition(2.7)` went through without an error, and `edition_get()` returned that number. Internal functions then compare the edition with `>= 3`: 2.7 behaved like edition 2, 42 like edition 3, without any signal.

{testthat} 3.3.0 now requires a whole number between 2 and 3.

## The remedy

Set the edition in the package's `DESCRIPTION` file, and only use `local_edition()` with 2 or 3, inside a specific test.

::: {.piege packages="testthat"}
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(testthat))

local_edition(3)
edition_get()
```
:::

In `DESCRIPTION`: `Config/testthat/edition: 3`.
